purpose: Classify repository changes and preserve the completed study's frozen scientific identity.

scientific_specification.policy: The completed study must not be amended in place.
required_actions: create a new immutable external anchor before primary data acquisition
perform fresh primary data acquisition under the new anchor
perform a fresh full execution and release gate
do not reuse the previous release's results as results of the new specification

published_evidence.policy: Historical evidence is not rewritten to make the completed study agree with a later interpretation.
required_actions: use a fresh execution or successor study when scientific claims must change

governance_overlay.policy: May strengthen auditability without changing the frozen experiment.
required_actions: keep governance claims grounded in committed evidence

operational_automation.policy: May improve automation around the release but must not redefine or weaken the frozen scientific gate.
required_actions: do not weaken full empirical replay

release_documentation.policy: May describe the completed study, deviations, or future work; frozen protocol and study-design documents remain immutable.
required_actions: do not overstate unsupported governance capabilities

default_policy: Review manually; absence from the policy is not permission to alter the completed study's scientific identity or historical evidence.
